senses.en: Harm that makes something less useful, valuable, or healthy.

senses.zh: làm hư hại; gây thiệt hại
senses.en: Harm something or make it less effective.

ex.en: The storm caused serious damage to our garden shed.
Uncontrolled tourism can damage fragile ecosystems and reduce the quality of life for local residents.

col: damage to property｜thiệt hại đối với tài sản
damage someone's reputation｜làm tổn hại danh tiếng của ai
tip: Thiệt hại nói chung dùng damage không đếm được; damages là tiền bồi thường theo luật.

senses.en: A soft material full of holes that absorbs liquid.
A simple aquatic animal with many pores in its body.
To clean or wipe something using a damp sponge.

ex.en: Use a damp sponge to wipe the kitchen table.
Urban wetlands act like a sponge, absorbing excess rainwater and reducing the risk of flooding.

col: a damp sponge｜miếng bọt biển ẩm
squeeze out a sponge｜vắt kiệt miếng bọt biển
sponge something down｜lau chùi bằng miếng bọt biển ẩm
tip: Khi nói ai hấp thụ nhanh, dùng cách ví von like a sponge.

senses.en: to take someone into police custody under legal authority
the act of taking someone into police custody
to stop the progress or development of something

ex.en: Police arrested the suspect outside the station yesterday.
Early investment in building maintenance can arrest the decline of historic neighbourhoods and preserve their distinctive character.

col: arrest someone for theft｜bắt ai vì tội trộm cắp
make an arrest｜tiến hành bắt giữ
arrest the decline｜ngăn chặn sự suy giảm
tip: Bị bắt vì việc gì dùng be arrested for; under arrest chỉ trạng thái đang bị bắt.

senses.en: Alive now, rather than dead or without life.

senses.zh: kế sinh nhai; thu nhập kiếm sống
senses.en: Money earned to pay for everyday needs.
The way people live and meet their everyday needs.

ex.en: The pond is full of tiny living creatures.
Rising housing costs make it harder for young adults to earn a decent living in major cities.

col: cost of living｜chi phí sinh hoạt
tip: living có thể đứng trước danh từ; alive thường làm vị ngữ hoặc đứng sau danh từ.

senses.en: funny or entertaining in a pleasant way

ex.en: My cousin told an amusing story about his cat.
Teachers can use amusing examples to maintain students' attention while explaining difficult concepts in science lessons.

col: find something amusing｜thấy điều gì buồn cười
tip: amusing mô tả điều gây cười; amused mô tả người thấy buồn cười.

senses.en: A container made of cardboard, often used for food or drinks.

ex.en: Please put the milk carton back in the fridge.
Local recycling schemes should explain how residents can dispose of each type of food carton correctly.

col: a carton of milk｜một hộp sữa
tip: a carton of milk là một hộp sữa; đừng nhầm với cartoon.

senses.en: Feeling thankful for kindness, help, or something good.

ex.en: I am grateful for your help with the move.
Many students are grateful for scholarships that allow them to continue their education despite financial difficulties.

col: grateful for something｜biết ơn vì điều gì
tip: be grateful to sb for sth; lưu ý viết đúng là grateful, không phải greatful.

senses.zh: bình minh; lúc mặt trời mọc
senses.en: The appearance of the sun above the horizon each morning.

ex.en: We woke early to watch the sunrise over the lake.
Outdoor activities scheduled around sunrise allow tourists to enjoy cooler temperatures and observe local wildlife.

col: before sunrise｜trước khi mặt trời mọc
tip: Lúc mặt trời mọc dùng at sunrise; hoàng hôn là sunset.

senses.en: The middle part of your body above your hips.
The part of a garment that fits around your waist.

ex.en: These trousers fit perfectly around my waist now.
Measuring waist size can help health professionals assess certain risks associated with excess body fat.

col: from the waist up｜từ eo trở lên
tip: waist là eo, đồng âm với waste (lãng phí).

senses.en: a person who rides a bicycle

ex.en: The cyclist stopped beside the bridge for water.
Protected cycle lanes can reduce the risk of collisions between cyclists and motor vehicles in busy cities.

col: commuter cyclist｜người đi làm bằng xe đạp
professional cyclist｜vận động viên xe đạp chuyên nghiệp
cyclist safety｜an toàn cho người đi xe đạp
tip: cyclist chỉ người đi xe đạp, không chỉ người đi xe máy.

senses.en: written dialogue or translation displayed on a screen
an additional title explaining a work's main title
to add written dialogue or translation to a film

ex.en: We watched the film with subtitles because the dialogue was quiet.
Subtitles can support language learning by helping viewers connect spoken expressions with their written forms.

col: add a subtitle｜thêm tiêu đề phụ
tip: Phụ đề phim thường dùng số nhiều subtitles; số ít còn có thể là tiêu đề phụ.

senses.en: return to health or a normal condition after difficulty
get back something lost, stolen, or spent

ex.en: It took several days to recover from the flu.
Local economies often recover more quickly when governments provide timely support for small businesses.

col: recover lost data｜khôi phục dữ liệu bị mất
tip: Hồi phục sau bệnh hoặc thất bại dùng recover from.

senses.zh: gật đầu; gật đầu ra hiệu
senses.en: to move your head down and up to communicate
a downward and upward head movement expressing a message

ex.en: She nodded when I offered her another cup of tea.
During group discussions, participants may nod to show understanding without necessarily agreeing with the speaker's views.

col: nod in agreement｜gật đầu đồng ý
give a nod｜gật đầu một cái
nod at someone｜gật đầu chào ai
tip: Quá khứ nodded và phân từ nodding đều gấp đôi chữ d.

senses.en: A brass musical instrument with three valves and a bright sound.

senses.zh: khoe khoang rùm beng; ca ngợi ầm ĩ
senses.en: To announce or praise something loudly and publicly.
To make a loud sound like an elephant's call.

ex.en: The musician lifted her trumpet and played a cheerful tune.
Learning the trumpet in a school orchestra can improve students' concentration and ability to cooperate with others.

col: trumpet achievements｜khoe khoang rùm beng các thành tựu
tip: Nghĩa nhạc cụ là kèn trumpet; động từ có thể chỉ việc rầm rộ quảng bá.

senses.en: covered with sand or containing a lot of sand
light yellowish brown in colour, especially describing hair

ex.en: We left our shoes beside the sandy path.
Sandy soils often require careful irrigation because they retain less water than soils with more clay.

tip: sandy vừa tả mặt đất nhiều cát, vừa tả màu tóc vàng nâu nhạt.

senses.en: A belief or custom passed down through generations.

ex.en: Making dumplings together is a tradition in our family.
Schools can help preserve local traditions by inviting older residents to share their knowledge and practical skills.

col: preserve a tradition｜giữ gìn truyền thống
break with tradition｜phá vỡ truyền thống
tip: Một tục lệ cụ thể thì đếm được; truyền thống nói chung có thể không đếm được, như break with tradition.

senses.en: The ocean between the Americas and Europe and Africa.

senses.zh: thuộc Đại Tây Dương; ven Đại Tây Dương
senses.en: Relating to the Atlantic Ocean or its surrounding regions.

ex.en: We watched huge waves roll in from the Atlantic.
Changes in Atlantic ocean currents could influence weather patterns and agricultural production across several continents.

col: cross the Atlantic｜vượt Đại Tây Dương
the Atlantic coast｜bờ Đại Tây Dương
tip: Viết hoa chữ đầu; làm danh từ thường dùng the Atlantic.

senses.en: to make a high sound with lips or escaping air
a small device blown to produce a high, clear sound
a high, clear sound made by lips, air, or a device

ex.en: My brother whistles cheerful tunes while washing the dishes.
Lifeguards use whistles to attract swimmers' attention quickly when dangerous conditions develop near the shore.

col: whistle a tune｜huýt sáo một giai điệu
final whistle｜hồi còi kết thúc trận
whistle for help｜thổi còi cầu cứu
tip: Chữ t trong whistle không phát âm; thổi còi dùng blow a whistle.

senses.en: Physical power to lift, move, or resist something.
A quality or skill that makes someone or something effective.
How strong, powerful, or resistant to damage something is.

ex.en: I needed all my strength to lift the suitcase.
Schools should help students identify their strengths rather than judge everyone solely through written examinations.

col: strengths and weaknesses｜điểm mạnh và điểm yếu
tip: Sức lực thường không đếm được; điểm mạnh thì đếm được.

senses.en: To pull something apart or make a hole by pulling.
A drop of liquid that comes from your eye.
A hole or split caused by pulling something apart.

ex.en: Be careful not to tear the paper bag.
Thin plastic bags tear easily, making them less suitable for repeated use than durable cloth alternatives.

tip: Nghĩa xé đọc /teə/, nước mắt đọc /tɪə/; động từ chia tore, torn.

senses.en: the armed force that operates mainly at sea

senses.zh: màu xanh hải quân; xanh thẫm
senses.en: a very dark blue colour
having a very dark blue colour

ex.en: My uncle joined the navy after leaving school.
The navy can support coastal communities by delivering emergency supplies after severe storms damage local roads.

col: join the navy｜gia nhập hải quân
serve in the navy｜phục vụ trong hải quân
tip: navy chỉ lực lượng hải quân nói chung; một chiếc tàu chiến cụ thể là warship.

senses.en: Lasting a short time or using few words.

senses.zh: thông báo tóm tắt; chỉ dẫn
senses.en: To give someone essential information or instructions.

senses.zh: bản mô tả yêu cầu công việc
senses.en: Instructions explaining what a task should achieve.

ex.en: We took a brief break before finishing the puzzle.
Teachers should brief students on safety procedures before allowing them to conduct experiments independently.

col: a brief summary｜bản tóm tắt ngắn gọn
a brief pause｜một khoảng ngừng ngắn
brief someone on｜thông báo cho ai về
a design brief｜bản mô tả yêu cầu thiết kế
tip: brief chỉ thời gian ngắn hoặc nội dung súc tích, bản thân không mang nghĩa qua loa.

senses.en: A long, narrow stick or post, often used for support.
Either of two opposite ends of Earth, a magnet, or battery.
Either of two completely opposite positions or qualities.

ex.en: We used a long pole to support the tent.
Climate change is affecting both poles, although the environmental consequences differ significantly between the two regions.

col: poles apart｜khác nhau một trời một vực
tip: pole đồng âm với poll; tên địa lý the North Pole phải viết hoa.

senses.zh: độc nhất vô nhị; độc đáo
senses.en: Unlike anything else, or the only one of its kind
Found only in a particular person, place, or thing

ex.en: Each handmade bowl has a unique pattern inside.
Protecting local crafts helps communities preserve their unique cultural identity in an increasingly globalised world.

col: unique to the region｜đặc trưng của vùng
tip: unique to nghĩa là chỉ có ở nơi nào đó; với nghĩa duy nhất không dùng very để bổ nghĩa.

senses.en: An object or collection of objects wrapped or boxed together.
A set of services or measures offered together.
To put something into a container for sale or transport.

ex.en: A small package arrived at our door this morning.
The government introduced a support package to help small businesses invest in cleaner production methods.

tip: Khi nói bưu kiện gửi qua đường bưu điện, Anh-Anh cũng hay dùng parcel.

senses.en: money borrowed and expected to be paid back

senses.zh: sự cho mượn; sự mượn tạm
senses.en: the temporary use of something belonging to someone else
to give money or something temporarily, expecting its return

ex.en: We took out a loan to repair the roof.
Affordable student loans can widen access to university, although repayment may create financial pressure after graduation.

col: take out a loan｜vay một khoản
repay a loan｜trả nợ khoản vay
on loan｜đang cho mượn; đang mượn
tip: Làm động từ, loan nghĩa là cho vay, không phải vay.

senses.zh: bữa nửa buổi (bữa sáng muộn kiêm bữa trưa)
senses.en: A late morning meal combining breakfast and lunch.

ex.en: We enjoyed brunch on the balcony this morning.
Serving brunch allows local cafés to attract customers outside the traditional breakfast and lunch periods.

tip: Ghép từ breakfast và lunch, chỉ bữa ăn gộp hai bữa.

senses.en: not allowed by a rule, law, or authority

ex.en: Taking photos is forbidden inside this small museum.
In many protected areas, hunting is strictly forbidden to preserve wildlife populations and maintain ecological balance.

col: forbidden by law｜bị pháp luật cấm
tip: Cũng là phân từ quá khứ của forbid; quá khứ là forbade.

senses.en: in the end, especially after a long time or difficulty

ex.en: After searching every room, we eventually found the missing keys.
Investment in public transport may initially be expensive, but it can eventually reduce congestion and improve urban life.

col: eventually lead to｜cuối cùng dẫn đến
tip: Nhấn mạnh kết quả sau một thời gian dài hoặc khó khăn, không mang nghĩa “có thể”.

senses.en: Something wrong with an object, system, or person's character
Responsibility for a mistake or something bad that happened
A break in rock where sections have moved apart

ex.en: A small electrical fault stopped the washing machine yesterday.
Regular inspections can identify a structural fault before it threatens the safety of residents.

col: find fault with｜bới lông tìm vết
tip: It's my fault nghĩa là “là lỗi của tôi”, không thay bằng mistake.

senses.en: an object wrapped for sending by post or delivery
a piece of land considered as a single unit
to wrap something, or divide it into portions for distribution

ex.en: A small parcel arrived for you this morning.
The growing volume of parcel deliveries has encouraged cities to explore cleaner transport options for local distribution.

col: a parcel of land｜một thửa đất
parcel something up｜gói thứ gì đó lại
parcel something out｜chia thứ gì đó ra
tip: Anh-Anh thường dùng parcel cho bưu kiện, Anh-Mỹ thường dùng package.

senses.en: Soft, wet earth made when soil mixes with water.

ex.en: Our boots were covered in mud after the walk.
Heavy rainfall can turn unpaved roads into mud, making rural communities difficult to reach.

col: get stuck in the mud｜sa lầy vào bùn
tip: mud thường không đếm được; tính từ chỉ lầy lội là muddy.

senses.en: a group of words expressing an idea or forming a unit
to express something using particular words

ex.en: I learned a useful phrase in my English class today.
Researchers must phrase survey questions carefully to avoid influencing participants and reducing the reliability of their findings.

col: a common phrase｜một cụm từ thông dụng
phrase a question｜diễn đạt một câu hỏi
a useful phrase｜một cụm từ hữu ích
tip: phrase là cụm từ, không nhất thiết là câu hoàn chỉnh.

senses.en: Unhappy, worried, or disappointed about something.

senses.zh: làm buồn lòng; làm lo lắng
senses.en: To make someone feel unhappy or worried.
To disturb the usual arrangement or balance of something.

ex.en: Lena felt upset when she lost her favourite scarf.
Sudden changes to school routines can upset younger children, who often rely on predictable daily activities.

col: upset about something｜bực bội vì điều gì
upset the balance｜phá vỡ sự cân bằng
upset someone's plans｜làm rối kế hoạch của ai
tip: Quá khứ và phân từ quá khứ của động từ vẫn là upset; danh từ nhấn trọng âm ở trước.

senses.en: Relating to one person or thing rather than a group
One person or living thing considered separately from others
Having qualities that make someone or something different from others

ex.en: The teacher gave each child an individual box of crayons.
Education systems should recognise individual learning needs rather than expect every student to progress at the same pace.

col: individual differences｜sự khác biệt giữa các cá nhân
a talented individual｜một người tài năng
tip: Tính từ nhấn mạnh từng cá nhân hay từng cái riêng lẻ; danh từ đếm được chỉ một người hay một cá thể.

senses.en: taking part in or connected with something
complicated and difficult to understand

ex.en: Everyone involved in the picnic brought something to share.
Residents should be actively involved in planning decisions that affect the future of their neighbourhoods.

col: an involved process｜một quá trình phức tạp
tip: Tham gia vào việc gì dùng be involved in; có thể đứng sau danh từ để bổ nghĩa.

senses.en: completely; in every way or to the fullest degree

ex.en: I totally forgot to bring my swimming costume.
Online courses cannot totally replace classroom teaching because students also benefit from direct social interaction.

col: totally unacceptable｜hoàn toàn không thể chấp nhận
tip: Sắc thái mạnh; trong văn viết trang trọng có thể thay bằng completely hoặc entirely.

senses.en: Put something where people can see it

senses.zh: buổi trưng bày; sự bày biện
senses.en: An arrangement of things for people to look at
A screen that shows information or images

ex.en: The bakery displays fresh cakes beside the front window.
Museums increasingly display everyday objects to illustrate how ordinary people lived in the past.

col: a colourful display｜màn trưng bày đầy màu sắc
digital display｜màn hình kỹ thuật số
tip: on display nghĩa là “đang được trưng bày”, không có mạo từ ở giữa.

senses.en: with a particular amount taken away
below zero
a disadvantage or negative feature

ex.en: Ten minus three leaves enough apples for everyone.
A household's disposable income is its total income minus taxes and other compulsory payments.

col: pluses and minuses｜ưu điểm và nhược điểm
tip: minus có thể nghĩa là trừ đi, hoặc đặt trước nhiệt độ để chỉ dưới không.

senses.zh: thư gửi bằng đường hàng không
senses.en: letters and parcels transported by aircraft, or this postal service

ex.en: We sent the parcel by airmail yesterday morning.
Although digital communication dominates international business, airmail remains useful for sending original documents overseas.

col: send something by airmail｜gửi thứ gì bằng đường hàng không
airmail service｜dịch vụ thư hàng không
tip: Nói về phương thức gửi dùng by airmail, không có mạo từ.

senses.zh: bị đánh cắp; bị mất trộm
senses.en: taken from its owner without permission

senses.zh: bị trộm (phân từ quá khứ của steal)
senses.en: taken something without permission, as the past participle of steal

ex.en: The police found my stolen bicycle behind a garage.
Stolen personal data can expose internet users to financial losses, highlighting the importance of effective online security.

col: a stolen vehicle｜chiếc xe bị đánh cắp
stolen data｜dữ liệu bị đánh cắp
tip: steal chia là steal, stole, stolen; stolen không dùng riêng làm thì quá khứ.

senses.en: A feeling of happiness or enjoyment

senses.zh: điều thú vị; niềm hân hoan
senses.en: An activity or experience that brings enjoyment

ex.en: She takes great pleasure in growing herbs on her balcony.
Public libraries encourage reading for pleasure while providing affordable access to knowledge for people of all ages.

col: take pleasure in｜lấy làm vui khi
a great pleasure｜một niềm vui lớn
tip: Niềm vui nói chung không đếm được; một điều thú vị cụ thể thì dùng a pleasure.

senses.en: A paved path beside a street for pedestrians.

ex.en: Please keep your bicycle off the crowded sidewalk.
Planting trees along sidewalks can provide shade for pedestrians and reduce summer temperatures in cities.

col: sidewalk café｜quán cà phê vỉa hè
tip: sidewalk của Anh-Mỹ tương ứng với pavement của Anh-Anh.

senses.en: After a short amount of time.
In a brief, unfriendly or impatient way.

ex.en: The bus will arrive shortly, so get your bag ready.
Shortly after the new railway opened, local businesses reported a significant increase in customer visits.

tip: Nói “ngắn gọn” thường dùng briefly, không dùng shortly.

senses.en: Previously owned or used by someone else.
Learned from others rather than experienced directly.

senses.zh: theo cách đồ cũ; gián tiếp
senses.en: From a previous owner or through another person.

ex.en: I bought a secondhand bicycle from my neighbour.
Buying secondhand furniture can reduce household spending and limit the environmental impact of producing new goods.

tip: Cũng thường viết second-hand; nghĩa thông tin là điều không tự mình trải nghiệm.

senses.zh: sự tiến bộ; sự tiến triển
senses.en: improvement or movement towards a goal
to improve or move towards a more advanced stage

ex.en: You have made real progress with your swimming.
Regular feedback helps students monitor their progress and identify areas that require further practice.

tip: Danh từ không đếm được; động từ nhấn trọng âm ở sau, Anh-Anh /prəˈɡres/.

senses.en: The condition of lacking money for basic needs.

senses.zh: sự thiếu thốn; sự nghèo nàn
senses.en: A serious lack of something needed or valued.

ex.en: The charity helps local families living in poverty.
Improving access to education and stable employment can help reduce poverty across both rural and urban communities.

col: live in poverty｜sống trong nghèo đói
a poverty of ideas｜sự nghèo nàn về ý tưởng
tip: Danh từ không đếm được; “sống trong nghèo đói” dùng live in poverty.

senses.en: approved or issued by a government or organisation
someone with a position of authority in an organisation

ex.en: We checked the official website before booking our tickets.
Official statistics indicate that investment in public transport has increased steadily over the past decade.

col: official statistics｜số liệu thống kê chính thức
tip: official nhấn mạnh sự công nhận của cơ quan có thẩm quyền; formal nhấn mạnh hình thức hoặc dịp trang trọng.

senses.zh: sự đăng ký; việc ghi danh
senses.en: The process of officially recording details or joining something.

senses.zh: giấy đăng ký; giấy chứng nhận đăng ký
senses.en: An official document showing that something has been registered.

ex.en: Registration for the swimming course opens on Monday.
Online registration can improve access to public services, provided that support remains available for people without internet access.

tip: Đăng ký tham gia hoạt động nào đó thường dùng registration for.

senses.zh: có hướng dẫn viên; có người hướng dẫn
senses.en: led or supported by someone with knowledge or experience

ex.en: We joined a guided walk through the forest yesterday.
Guided learning can help students build confidence before they begin working independently on complex tasks.

col: guided tour｜tour có hướng dẫn viên
guided walk｜chuyến đi bộ có người dẫn đường
guided learning｜học tập có hướng dẫn
tip: guided tour là chuyến tham quan có hướng dẫn viên; guided còn là quá khứ phân từ của guide.

senses.en: extremely unpleasant, making you feel sick or strongly dislike something

senses.zh: đáng phẫn nộ; không thể chấp nhận
senses.en: so bad or wrong that it causes strong disapproval

ex.en: A disgusting smell came from the forgotten rubbish bag.
Residents described the illegal dumping of waste beside their homes as disgusting and demanded immediate action.

col: disgusting behaviour｜hành vi đáng ghê tởm
tip: disgusting mô tả điều gây ghê tởm; disgusted mô tả người cảm thấy ghê tởm.

senses.en: Walk with firm, regular steps, often in a group.

senses.zh: cuộc tuần hành; cuộc hành quân
senses.en: An organised walk by a group, often to protest.
Music with a strong regular rhythm suitable for marching.

ex.en: The band marched through the square in bright uniforms.
Residents organised a peaceful march to demand safer roads and better public transport in their neighbourhood.

col: march through the streets｜diễu hành qua các con phố
a protest march｜cuộc tuần hành phản đối
a peaceful march｜cuộc tuần hành hòa bình
a military march｜hành khúc quân đội
tip: march viết thường là đi đều bước; March viết hoa là tháng Ba.

senses.zh: mỗi khi; bất cứ khi nào
senses.en: Every time that something happens.

senses.zh: bất cứ lúc nào; lúc nào cũng được
senses.en: At any time that something happens or is convenient.
Used in questions to express surprise about when something happened.

ex.en: Whenever I cook soup, my cat waits beside the stove.
Whenever cities expand, planners should consider how new developments will affect existing communities and local wildlife.

col: whenever possible｜bất cứ khi nào có thể
whenever you like｜bất cứ lúc nào bạn muốn
tip: Khi dẫn mệnh đề chỉ thời gian ở tương lai, thường dùng hiện tại đơn, không dùng will.

senses.en: Arrange to keep something for a particular person or purpose.
A supply kept for use when needed.
An area where wildlife and natural habitats are protected.

ex.en: Could you reserve a table for us tonight?
Governments should maintain adequate food reserves to protect vulnerable communities during periods of severe drought.

col: reserve something for someone｜để dành cái gì cho ai
nature reserve｜khu bảo tồn thiên nhiên
tip: Động từ thường dùng reserve sth for sb; trữ lượng thường dùng reserves.

senses.en: An idea or feeling formed about someone or something.
A performance copying someone's voice, appearance, or behaviour.
A mark left by pressing something into a surface.

ex.en: Her warm welcome gave me a good first impression.
The appearance of public spaces can strongly influence visitors' overall impression of a city.

col: make an impression on｜gây ấn tượng với
be under the impression that｜nghĩ rằng
do an impression of｜bắt chước ai
tip: under the impression that nghĩa là “tưởng rằng”, thường ngụ ý hiểu nhầm.

senses.en: to cause a change in someone or something
to cause someone to feel a strong emotion

ex.en: Too much coffee can affect how well you sleep.
Rising food prices disproportionately affect poorer households, which spend a larger share of their income on essentials.

col: affect health｜ảnh hưởng đến sức khỏe
deeply affect someone｜làm ai xúc động sâu sắc
affect performance｜ảnh hưởng đến hiệu suất
tip: Với nghĩa “ảnh hưởng”, affect là động từ, còn effect thường là danh từ.

senses.zh: nhà thờ chính tòa; thánh đường
senses.en: The main church of a district led by a bishop.

ex.en: Sunlight streamed through the cathedral's beautiful stained glass windows.
Restoring a historic cathedral can preserve traditional craftsmanship while attracting visitors who support the local economy.

col: medieval cathedral｜nhà thờ lớn thời Trung cổ
cathedral restoration｜trùng tu nhà thờ lớn
tip: Nghĩa chặt chẽ là nhà thờ chính tòa của giám mục, không phải mọi nhà thờ lớn.

senses.en: Something that makes success more likely than for others.
A useful or positive feature of something.

ex.en: Your long arms give you an advantage in swimming.
One major advantage of public transport is its ability to reduce traffic congestion in urban areas.

col: have an advantage over｜có lợi thế hơn
take advantage of｜tận dụng; lợi dụng
a major advantage｜một lợi thế lớn
tip: take advantage of có thể là tận dụng cơ hội hoặc lợi dụng người khác.

senses.en: Causing discomfort, dislike, or unhappiness.
Behaving in an unfriendly or rude way.

ex.en: An unpleasant smell was coming from the kitchen bin.
Although commuting can be unpleasant, reliable public transport can reduce stress and improve the daily experience of workers.

col: an unpleasant experience｜một trải nghiệm không dễ chịu
unpleasant side effects｜tác dụng phụ khó chịu
unpleasant to someone｜khó chịu với ai
tip: Khi nói về sự vật là gây khó chịu; nói về người thường chỉ thái độ không thân thiện.

senses.en: a group of things sharing particular features

ex.en: Put each book into the category that fits best.
Researchers divided household spending into several categories to identify changes in consumer behaviour.

col: fall into a category｜thuộc một loại
divide into categories｜chia thành các loại
tip: Thường dùng fall into a category với nghĩa “thuộc về một loại”.

senses.en: in a friendly and welcoming way
in a way that keeps someone comfortably warm

ex.en: The neighbours smiled and greeted us warmly this morning.
When schools welcome new students warmly, they can reduce anxiety and encourage participation in classroom activities.

tip: greet warmly là chào hỏi nồng nhiệt; dress warmly là mặc đủ ấm.

senses.en: a series of events or stages that repeats
to travel by bicycle
a vehicle with two wheels powered by pedalling

ex.en: I usually cycle to the park on sunny mornings.
Climate change can disrupt the natural water cycle, increasing the frequency of droughts and floods in some regions.

col: cycle to work｜đạp xe đi làm
tip: Động từ cycle nghĩa là đạp xe; đạp xe đi làm là cycle to work.

senses.en: the city where a country or region's government is based
money or assets used to start or operate a business
a letter in its large form

ex.en: We visited the capital and explored its busy markets.
Small businesses often struggle to obtain enough capital to invest in new equipment and staff training.

col: the capital city｜thành phố thủ đô
a capital letter｜chữ cái viết hoa
tip: Nghĩa vốn thường không đếm được; nghĩa chữ in hoa thì đếm được.

senses.zh: người hướng dẫn; huấn luyện viên
senses.en: Someone who teaches a particular skill or activity.
A teacher at an American college or university.

ex.en: Our swimming instructor showed us how to breathe properly.
A qualified instructor can help older adults exercise safely and develop confidence in their physical abilities.

col: qualified instructor｜người hướng dẫn có chứng chỉ
fitness instructor｜huấn luyện viên thể hình
tip: Thường chỉ người dạy kỹ năng cụ thể như lái xe, bơi lội.

senses.en: A roadside hotel with convenient parking for guests.

ex.en: We found a quiet motel just outside the town.
Affordable motels along major roads provide convenient accommodation for travellers exploring rural areas by car.

col: stay at a motel｜ở nhà nghỉ ven đường
tip: motel chủ yếu phục vụ khách đi ô tô, thường có chỗ đỗ xe thuận tiện.

senses.zh: vận động viên nam; người yêu thể thao (nam)
senses.en: a man who plays sports, especially with skill

ex.en: My uncle was a keen sportsman in his youth.
A successful sportsman can encourage young people to exercise regularly and develop confidence through physical activity.

col: keen sportsman｜người đàn ông đam mê thể thao
professional sportsman｜vận động viên nam chuyên nghiệp
talented sportsman｜vận động viên nam có tài
tip: Chỉ riêng nam giới; khi không muốn nhấn mạnh giới tính có thể dùng athlete.

senses.en: something carried, or the amount a vehicle or person carries
to put goods into something or data into computer memory

senses.zh: khối lượng công việc; gánh nặng
senses.en: the amount of work or responsibility someone must manage

ex.en: The donkey carried a heavy load up the hill.
Sharing household tasks more equally can reduce the load on parents who also work full time.

col: load a truck｜chất hàng lên xe tải
a load of laundry｜một mẻ quần áo cần giặt
tip: load A with B nghĩa là chất B lên A; dỡ hàng là unload.

senses.zh: người đưa tin; người truyền tin
senses.en: a person who carries a message to someone

ex.en: A messenger arrived with an envelope for the manager.
Before modern telecommunications, governments relied on messengers to carry important information between distant towns and military posts.

col: send a messenger｜cử người đưa tin
bike messenger｜nhân viên chuyển phát bằng xe đạp
act as a messenger｜đóng vai trò người truyền tin
tip: message là tin nhắn; messenger là người chuyển tin.

senses.en: to produce books or other writing for public reading
to make information officially available to the public

ex.en: The local magazine published my photograph of the river.
Researchers should publish their findings openly so that policymakers can make decisions based on reliable evidence.

col: publish findings｜công bố kết quả nghiên cứu
tip: publish nhấn mạnh việc phát hành hoặc công bố ra công chúng, không chỉ là in ấn.

senses.zh: sự hài hước; óc hài hước
senses.en: The quality of being funny or the ability to appreciate funniness.
A person's mood or state of mind.
To agree with someone's wishes to keep them happy.

ex.en: Her gentle humour made everyone at dinner feel relaxed.
Teachers can use humour to reduce classroom anxiety and encourage students to participate more confidently.

col: a sense of humour｜khiếu hài hước
tip: Anh-Anh viết humour, Anh-Mỹ viết humor; làm động từ có nghĩa chiều theo ai.

senses.en: a small attached piece giving information about something
to attach a label or identifying marker to something
a chasing game where players touch others to catch them

ex.en: I checked the tag before washing my new jumper.
Researchers tag marine animals to track their movements and identify habitats that require stronger environmental protection.

col: tag someone in a photo｜gắn thẻ ai trong ảnh
tip: Quá khứ là tagged; tag along nghĩa là đi theo.

senses.en: to enter water headfirst or swim beneath its surface
to move downwards suddenly and quickly

senses.zh: cú nhảy; cú lặn; sự sụt giảm
senses.en: an act of diving or a sudden sharp fall

ex.en: We watched a swimmer dive smoothly into the pool.
Tourists who dive near coral reefs should avoid touching marine organisms to prevent damage to fragile ecosystems.

col: dive into the water｜nhảy xuống nước
tip: Quá khứ Anh-Anh thường dùng dived; Anh-Mỹ cũng dùng dove.

senses.en: Ask someone to pay a particular amount for something.
An amount of money requested for goods or services.
Put electrical energy into a battery or device.

ex.en: They charge extra if you want breakfast in your room.
Museums that charge admission fees should offer discounts to ensure that students can still access cultural resources.

tip: Tính phí ai về khoản nào dùng charge someone for something.

senses.en: A high, very steep rock face, often beside the sea.

ex.en: We watched seabirds nesting halfway up the cliff.
Coastal erosion can weaken a cliff over time, putting nearby homes and walking routes at risk.

col: a sheer cliff｜vách đá dựng đứng
tip: cliff nhấn mạnh vách đá dốc đứng, không chỉ sườn đồi nói chung.

senses.en: Things or materials referred to without naming them specifically.
To fill something tightly or push something into a space.

ex.en: Please move your stuff off the kitchen table.
Consumers often buy stuff they rarely use, contributing to household waste and unnecessary resource consumption.

col: stuff a bag with｜nhét đầy túi bằng
tip: Danh từ stuff không đếm được và mang tính khẩu ngữ; trong văn viết trang trọng nên dùng danh từ cụ thể.

senses.en: Waste left scattered in public places.
To leave rubbish or other objects scattered across a place.
A group of young animals born to one mother together.

ex.en: We picked up litter along the beach before lunch.
Reducing litter in urban parks requires convenient bins as well as sustained public education campaigns.

col: a litter of puppies｜một lứa chó con
tip: Nghĩa rác thì không đếm được; một lứa con non dùng a litter of.

senses.en: to make air, water, or land dirty or harmful

ex.en: Please don't pollute the stream by throwing rubbish into it.
Factories that pollute local rivers should face stricter penalties to protect ecosystems and public health.

col: pollute the environment｜làm ô nhiễm môi trường
pollute the air｜làm ô nhiễm không khí
tip: Ngoại động từ, đi thẳng với đối tượng bị ô nhiễm, không có giới từ.

senses.en: A large, round fruit with thick skin, often orange.

ex.en: We roasted a pumpkin and served it with rice.
Growing crops such as pumpkin in community gardens can improve access to fresh food in urban neighbourhoods.

tip: Cả quả bí ngô thì đếm được; bí ngô làm nguyên liệu nấu ăn thường không đếm được.

senses.en: the smallest living unit of an organism
a small room, especially one in a prison
a unit that produces electricity through chemical reactions

ex.en: Under the microscope, each onion cell looked like a rectangle.
Scientists study how damaged cells repair themselves to develop more effective treatments for disease.

tip: Trong sinh học thường chỉ tế bào; prison cell là phòng giam.

senses.en: In a soft, careful, or kind way.
With a gradual slope or a small, smooth movement.

ex.en: She gently lifted the kitten out of the basket.
Health professionals should speak gently to anxious patients to help them feel comfortable during medical examinations.

tip: Được tạo từ gentle bằng cách bỏ e cuối rồi thêm y.

senses.en: A small printed sheet giving information or advertising something.

ex.en: A volunteer handed me a leaflet about the new library.
Health centres can distribute a leaflet explaining how regular exercise helps prevent several common diseases.

tip: leaflet thường là một tờ hoặc tờ gấp; brochure thường là cuốn nhỏ.

senses.zh: thuộc văn hóa; liên quan đến văn hóa
senses.en: relating to a group's customs, beliefs, and way of life
relating to activities such as music, literature, and theatre

ex.en: The festival celebrates the town's rich cultural traditions.
Schools can promote cultural understanding by encouraging students to share their family traditions and experiences.

tip: cultural là liên quan đến văn hóa; cultured mô tả người có học thức, tao nhã.

senses.en: neither large nor small in size

ex.en: A medium-sized suitcase should hold everything for the weekend.
Medium-sized cities can offer diverse employment opportunities while maintaining shorter commuting times than major urban centres.

tip: Chỉ kích thước vừa phải, không có nghĩa chất lượng hay trình độ tầm thường.

senses.en: Located in, coming from, or relating to the south.

ex.en: We spent a week exploring the island's southern coast.
Southern regions of the country may face longer droughts as rising temperatures increase pressure on water supplies.

col: southern regions｜các khu vực phía nam
tip: Âm ou trong south đọc /aʊ/, còn nguyên âm trong southern đọc /ʌ/.

senses.en: To obtain something useful or increase in amount.
An increase in something or a benefit received.

ex.en: You will gain confidence after a few lessons.
Students can gain valuable practical experience by volunteering for projects that benefit their local communities.

col: gain access to｜có được quyền truy cập
tip: gain thường đi với kinh nghiệm, sự tự tin; thắng trận thường dùng win.

senses.en: A thick bed covering, or a layer covering something.
Applying to everyone or everything without considering individual differences.
To cover something completely with a layer.

ex.en: She wrapped a soft blanket around her cold shoulders.
A blanket ban on private vehicles may disadvantage residents who cannot easily access public transport.

col: a blanket of snow｜một lớp tuyết dày
a blanket ban｜lệnh cấm toàn diện
tip: Làm tính từ, blanket nghĩa là áp dụng chung cho tất cả, như blanket ban.

senses.zh: thuộc kỹ thuật; thuộc công nghệ
senses.en: relating to practical skills, machinery, or scientific methods
using specialist knowledge or language in a particular subject

ex.en: We called an engineer to solve the technical problem.
Schools should teach technical skills alongside academic subjects to prepare students for a changing workplace.

tip: technical nhấn mạnh kỹ thuật hoặc kiến thức chuyên môn, không có nghĩa là công nghệ cao.

senses.en: the process of sharing information, ideas, or feelings
a formal message sent to someone

ex.en: Clear communication helps us share the kitchen without arguments.
Effective communication between healthcare professionals and patients can improve treatment outcomes and reduce misunderstandings.

col: nonverbal communication｜giao tiếp phi ngôn ngữ
a breakdown in communication｜sự đứt gãy trong giao tiếp
tip: Nghĩa giao tiếp thường không đếm được; một văn bản chính thức thì đếm được.

senses.en: the absence of light

ex.en: We searched for the torch in complete darkness.
Artificial lighting reduces natural darkness in urban areas, potentially disrupting the sleep patterns of residents and wildlife.

col: under cover of darkness｜dưới màn đêm che chở
tip: Thường không đếm được; in darkness nghĩa là trong bóng tối.

senses.en: an agreement between people or organisations, especially in business
to take action about a problem, usually with with
to give cards or other things to several people

ex.en: We got a good deal on our new sofa.
Governments must deal with housing shortages by supporting affordable construction and improving public transport links.

col: make a deal｜chốt một thỏa thuận
deal with a problem｜giải quyết vấn đề
tip: deal with nghĩa là xử lý; a great deal of đi với danh từ không đếm được.

senses.en: Strange or different from what is expected.
Not divisible by two without a remainder.
Occasional rather than regular or frequent.

ex.en: There is an odd smell coming from the fridge.
It may seem odd that some rapidly growing cities still lack reliable access to clean drinking water.

col: odd jobs｜việc vặt; công việc tạm thời
tip: the odd + danh từ số ít thường nghĩa là “thỉnh thoảng có một…”.

senses.en: A small container for cigarette ash and cigarette ends

ex.en: An empty glass ashtray stood on the outdoor table.
Providing ashtrays in designated smoking areas can reduce cigarette litter, although broader measures are needed to protect public health.

col: a glass ashtray｜gạt tàn thủy tinh
a cigarette ashtray｜gạt tàn thuốc lá
tip: Danh từ đếm được, ghép từ ash (tro) và tray (khay).

senses.en: one of the foods used to prepare a dish

senses.zh: yếu tố; thành phần cần thiết
senses.en: one of the things needed to achieve a particular result

ex.en: Fresh ginger is the main ingredient in this soup.
Public trust is an essential ingredient in the successful implementation of environmental policies.

tip: Danh từ đếm được; vừa chỉ nguyên liệu nấu ăn, vừa chỉ yếu tố cần thiết theo nghĩa bóng.

senses.zh: lời xin lỗi; sự hối tiếc
senses.en: words expressing regret for something wrong or hurtful

ex.en: I sent my neighbour an apology for the noise.
A sincere public apology can help organisations rebuild trust after mistakes, but practical changes are also necessary.

col: offer an apology｜gửi lời xin lỗi
accept an apology｜chấp nhận lời xin lỗi
a sincere apology｜lời xin lỗi chân thành
owe someone an apology｜nợ ai một lời xin lỗi
tip: Xin lỗi ai về việc gì dùng apology to someone for something.

senses.en: A sheltered area of water where boats can stay safely.

senses.zh: nuôi dưỡng (ý nghĩ, cảm xúc); ấp ủ
senses.en: To keep a thought or feeling, often secretly.
To hide or shelter someone, especially someone wanted by authorities.

ex.en: Small fishing boats returned to the harbour before sunset.
Expanding the harbour could increase trade, but construction may damage nearby coastal habitats.

col: a natural harbour｜một cảng tự nhiên
tip: Anh-Anh viết harbour, Anh-Mỹ viết harbor.

senses.en: Expressed in writing rather than speech.

senses.zh: viết (phân từ quá khứ của write)
senses.en: Past participle of write.

ex.en: Please send written instructions so I can follow them.
Written feedback allows students to review their mistakes and improve their performance over time.

col: written permission｜sự cho phép bằng văn bản
written agreement｜thỏa thuận bằng văn bản
written feedback｜phản hồi bằng văn bản
tip: write chia là write, wrote, written.

senses.en: having no writing, pictures, or other content
showing no understanding, feeling, or recognition
an empty space where information should be added

ex.en: She handed me a blank sheet and some pencils.
A blank page can encourage creative thinking by allowing learners to organise ideas without a fixed template.

col: a blank expression｜vẻ mặt ngây ra
fill in the blanks｜điền vào chỗ trống
tip: go blank có thể nghĩa là đầu óc bỗng trống rỗng, không nhớ ra được gì.

senses.zh: thời gian rảnh; sự nhàn rỗi
senses.en: Time when you are free from work or other duties.

ex.en: She spends most of her leisure time in the garden.
Public parks provide affordable spaces for leisure, helping urban residents relax and maintain social connections.

col: at your leisure｜khi nào thuận tiện cho bạn; một cách thong thả
tip: leisure thường không đếm được; leisure time nghĩa là thời gian rảnh.

senses.en: Ready to deal with something because of previous planning.
Willing to do something, especially something difficult or unpleasant.

ex.en: With spare batteries packed, we were prepared for a blackout.
Graduates who gain practical experience are often better prepared for the demands of a competitive labour market.

col: prepared for emergencies｜sẵn sàng cho các tình huống khẩn cấp
prepared to compromise｜sẵn sàng nhượng bộ
tip: prepared for + danh từ; prepared to do có thể mang nghĩa sẵn lòng.

senses.en: The act of entering, or permission to enter a place.
An individual item in a list, diary, or reference work.
A work or person submitted for a competition.

ex.en: Entry to the swimming pool is free today.
Strict entry requirements may prevent capable students from disadvantaged backgrounds from accessing higher education opportunities.

tip: Vào một nơi thường dùng entry to; lối vào cụ thể thường dùng entrance.
